card.name: Inside arsenic compound names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the pieces of the word arsenic and its compounds (arsen, ars, son), such as arsenic trioxide, arsenates and methylarsonic acid. It also fires weakly inside phenylacetylglutamine.

modes.label: Arsenic word pieces
modes.description: Pieces of arsenic, arsenate or arsinic words, usually before the ending is completed.
